$description: Which view of each Verdant screen reads which collection, filtered and ordered how — the rules proto/verdant.html renders, stated for the backend. Hand-written design input; agent-layer/gen-handoff.mjs projects it into handoff/verdant/pack.json#/bindings. A view binds a record shape, never an endpoint (epic #329 D1).

views.order: status overdue, then due, then ok; plants of equal status keep the order the collection is served in
views.pick: the first plant after ordering is the featured plant; the page gives it no heading

views.filter: plantId equals the featured plant's id

views.title: Needs attention today
views.filter: done is false and status is due or overdue, which is every open task due on or before scenario.json's today; nothing later appears
views.order: as served; the screen does not sort this list

views.title: All plants
views.filter: every plant except the featured one
views.order: status overdue, then due, then ok; plants of equal status keep the order the collection is served in

notInScope: a plant-detail screen: each plant card links to #plant-<id> and no screen renders that target
